title: ActMem: From Latent Memory Reasoning to Grounded Robotic Action
abstract: arXiv:2611.25461v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising results in real-world long-horizon manipulation, where memory plays a crucial role.   However, existing memory-augmented VLAs either retrieve past observations without reasoning about what they imply, or reason over the full   history in a shared context where it crowds out current perception. Cognitive science treats them as distinct systems: memory reconstructs past   experience to decide what to do, while perception guides how to act. We therefore propose ActMem, an in-context memory framework that   decouples memory reasoning from perceptual grounding within a single vision-language backbone. translated_title: ActMem：从潜在记忆推理到感知落地的机器人动作
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在真实世界的长时程操作任务中已展现出令人瞩目的成果，而记忆在其中扮演着至关重要的角色。然而，现有的记忆增强型VLA模型要么只是检索过去的观察而不对其含义进行推理，要么在共享上下文中对完整历史进行推理，从而挤占了当前的感知能力。认知科学将二者视为不同的系统：记忆重构过去的经验以决定“做什么”，而感知则引导“如何行动”。因此，我们提出ActMem，这是一个在单一视觉-语言骨干网络内将记忆推理与感知锚定解耦的上下文记忆框架。ActMem构建于具备原生视频理解能力的视觉-语言模型之上，它从带时间戳的交互历史中推断当前子任务，并将该推理过程中形成的隐藏状态保留为潜在记忆思维链，以此条件化流匹配动作生成……
tldr: 提出ActMem框架，在单一视觉-语言模型中将记忆推理与感知锚定解耦，通过潜在记忆思维链条件化流匹配动作生成，从而提升长时程机器人操作性能。
en_tdlr: ActMem decouples memory reasoning from perceptual grounding within a single vision-language backbone, using a Latent Memory Chain-of-Thought to condition flow-matching action generation for long-horizon robotic manipulation.
